name: Resize Images
tagline: Exact sizes for one image or a whole batch, by pixels or percentage. Nothing is uploaded.
description: Resize JPG, PNG and WebP images to exact pixels or a percentage, one or many at once. Free, private, and your photos never leave your device.

faq.a: No. They're resized inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Why is the result a little blurry when I make it bigger?
faq.a: Enlarging has to invent pixels that weren't there. Shrinking looks sharp; enlarging much past the original size always softens.
